textbookBox.concept: We can measure length with parts of our body. A hand span, a footstep and an arm are body units that everyone has.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: We can measure length with parts of our body. A hand span, a footstep and an arm are body units that everyone has.
beats.speakEn: We can measure length with parts of our body. A hand span, a footstep and an arm are body units that everyone has.

beats.en: Shelly and Adi want to know if a large table will pass through the door. They cannot lift the table, so they cut a thread as long as the table's breadth and check it against the door.

textbookBox.concept: Small units such as a pencil are slow to measure a long thing like a saree. A paper strip double the size of a pencil helps, and longer strips help even more.

beats.en: Small units such as a pencil are slow to measure a long thing like a saree. A paper strip double the size of a pencil helps, and longer strips help even more. A shopkeeper measures cloth with a metre rod.
beats.speakEn: Small units such as a pencil are slow to measure a long thing like a saree. A paper strip double the size of a pencil helps, and longer strips help even more. A shopkeeper measures cloth with a metre rod.

beats.en: Is everyone's head 3 hand spans round, and is a forearm as long as a foot? We can measure and see that these are not exactly true for every child. Before we measure, we estimate.
beats.speakEn: Is everyone's head 3 hand spans round, and is a forearm as long as a foot? We can measure and see that these are not exactly true for every child. Before we measure, we estimate.
